data.body: Progress (2026-11-19 PST): implemented per the signed plan; commit eafd914081e on a fresh worktree from origin/main, make verify running. New tests/unit/reconciler/test_create_writes_not_replayed.py (15 tests) failed 13/15 before the fix (the 2 passing are the unchanged-behaviour guards: Cloud 429 retry, DC read retry) and pass after. Library check: uv.lock pins jira 3.10.5; its source shows ResilientSession re-sends any method on requests ConnectionError and makes exactly 1 attempt at max_retries=0, and create_issue(prefetch=False) skips the follow-up GET. Not tested against the real library (not installed in any test tier). A broad local run of tests/unit/reconciler under -n 4 on a loaded host had 3 lock-ref test failures (test_lock_orphan_local_ref.py, state/test_ref_lock.py); they passed 23/23 in isolation and do not touch the changed files; make verify is the arbiter.
